notes.title: 2019.9.14 Update
notes.content:
Updated on 14 September:

Changed the body of jet-monsters from penetrable to solid.
Adjusted the exit position of some level.
Modified some text display details.

notes.title: 2019.9.6 Update
notes.content:
Fixed a position error caused by the last update.

Added the ability "Players can squat down while jumping".

Reduced the overall difficulty of the second and third level.

Reduced price of disposable drinks.

Build a wall in the bear town, so that bears won't fall to death while they jump too high.

notes.title: Update on 2019.9.4
notes.content:
Foodie Bear was available on Steam !!

Huge thanks to the players who have bought the game or paid attention to it.
If you have any suggestions about the game, Please review or just leave a message here and let me know.

You can also contact me on Facebook Page @FoodieBearSteam

update on 2019.9.4:

Modify the color of disposable items.
Modify a few errors about text display.
Adjust the position of some deadly spikes.
Adjust the prices of some items.

notes.title: Building a Practice Room
notes.content:
Hello everyone. Welcome to Foodie Bear !!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35573053/38cf576d40daf9d40e0600c39993658c327dfad9.gif[/img]
This game contains Intentionally Awkward Controls. And the level is randomized on the basis of simple grouping. 
With bear's size gets bigger, feeling of the game may change at the same time. When the characters die, they can only go back to the village to challenge from the very beginning.  

So now a training room is setting up to simulate the whole game, which can go on a simulation to challenge the last failed stage. At the same time, some benefits can be obtained to unlock useful items as soon as possible.

After creating practice room. Next step I want to make steam achievements, modify art works and test the game. See you in September !!
